recipe.title: Golden-hour café window portrait, film-look grade
recipe.summary: A 4:5 vertical portrait of a barista leaning on a café counter, lit by low warm sun through a window on the left, shot (or generated) with a shallow-depth-of-field 85 mm look, then graded warm with lifted shadows, soft film grain and a light vignette. Measured: 3456x4320, palette dominated by amber #D9A066 and espresso brown #3B2A22, warm temperature (R-B +31), left side 0.12 brighter than right, centre 3.4x sharper than edges, corners 0.78 of centre brightness.
recipe.likely_origin: AI-generated (no EXIF camera data, no C2PA) then colour-graded; a real 85 mm photo is also plausible

steps.title: Generate the base portrait
steps.produces: base_portrait.png - 4:5 vertical portrait with the final composition and lighting
steps.prompt: editorial lifestyle portrait of a young barista with curly dark hair and a rust-coloured linen apron, leaning on a wooden café counter, holding a ceramic cup, soft smile, looking slightly off camera, warm low golden-hour sunlight streaming through a large window from the left, long soft shadows, dust motes in the light beam, blurred espresso machine and hanging pendant lamps in the background, 85mm lens at f/1.8, eye-level medium close-up, rule-of-thirds framing with the face on the upper-left third, shallow depth of field with creamy bokeh, colour palette amber #D9A066, espresso brown #3B2A22, cream #EFE3D0, muted teal accents #4E6E6A, Kodak Portra 400 film look, natural skin texture --ar 4:5 --style raw --v 7 --stylize 150
steps.settings: Generate 4 variations, pick the one whose window light falls from the left and whose face sits on the upper-left third; upscale with 'Upscale (Subtle)'.
steps.evidence: No camera EXIF or lens data; left/right brightness bias +0.12 and warm R-B +31 indicate a warm key from the left; centre-vs-edge sharpness 3.4 implies shallow depth of field.

steps.prompt: Editorial lifestyle photograph, 4:5 vertical. A young barista with curly dark hair and a rust linen apron leans on a wooden café counter holding a ceramic cup, soft smile, gaze slightly off camera. Warm low golden-hour sun pours through a large window on the left, long soft shadows, visible dust in the light beam. Background: out-of-focus espresso machine and pendant lamps with creamy bokeh. Shot on an 85mm lens at f/1.8, eye level, medium close-up, face on the upper-left third. Amber, espresso brown, cream and muted teal palette, Kodak Portra 400 colour, natural skin texture, fine grain.
steps.negative_prompt: cartoon, illustration, 3d render, oversaturated, harsh flash, plastic skin, extra fingers, deformed hands, text, watermark, cold blue light
steps.settings: Resolution 1728x2160 (4:5); sampler Euler, scheduler simple, 28 steps, guidance 3.5 (Flux) / CFG 6 (SDXL); seed random; then 2x upscale in step 3.
steps.evidence: Same visual cues as step 1; offered for users without Midjourney.

steps.title: Upscale to the delivered resolution
steps.evidence: Delivered size 3456x4320 (14.9 MP) is exactly 2x a typical 1728x2160 4:5 generation.

steps.title: Warm film grade
steps.settings:
1. Basic: Temp +12, Tint +4, Exposure +0.15, Contrast -10, Highlights -35, Shadows +25, Whites -10, Blacks +18 (lifted, measured shadows p5 = 0.11).
2. Tone Curve (Point): raise the black point to output 18, slight S-curve (input 64 -> 58, input 192 -> 200).
3. Colour Mixer: Orange Saturation +8, Orange Luminance +6; Blue Hue -15, Blue Saturation -20 (pushes cool tones to muted teal).
4. Colour Grading: Shadows hue 200 / sat 8, Highlights hue 40 / sat 14, Balance +20.
5. Effects: Grain Amount 18, Size 25, Roughness 50; Post-Crop Vignette -14, Midpoint 40, Feather 70 (measured corners 0.78 of centre).
steps.evidence: Lifted blacks (0% clipped black), soft highlight roll-off (p95 0.86, 0.1% clipped white), warm/teal palette split and a measured vignette.
